name: archery
description: Architecture docs as code in VS Code: an arc42 document with a model-based UML editor for all 13 UML 2 diagram types, PDF/HTML export, and tools for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot that show their edits live.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No architecture documentation in this workspace.
[Initialize architecture documentation](command:archery.init)

languageModelTools.name: archery_add_element
languageModelTools.userDescription: Add an element (component, actor, external system, use case, node, class, port, ...) to the shared model.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Add an element (component, actor, external system, use case, node, class, port, ...) to the shared model. The id is derived from the name unless given and never changes later. Use parent for nesting (component in package/component, port on component, artifact or execution environment in node). With `diagram` it is also placed on that canvas diagram (at x/y if given), or added as the last lifeline of that sequence diagram.

languageModelTools.name: archery_delete_element
languageModelTools.userDescription: Delete an element from the model.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delete an element from the model. Fails if it is still used (relationships, diagrams, sequence lifelines, children) unless cascade is true, which also removes those relationships, diagram nodes/edges, lifelines and their messages, and moves children to the deleted element's parent.

languageModelTools.name: archery_add_relationship
languageModelTools.userDescription: Add a relationship between two model elements.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Add a relationship between two model elements. Kinds: dependency/usage (dashed arrow; use cases: stereotype "include" or "extend", an extend with condition and extensionPoint), association, aggregation, composition, generalization, realization, connector, deploy, manifest, link. By default the edge is also added to every canvas diagram that shows both elements.

qualifier.description: Qualifier at an association end, e.g. {from: "isbn"}

associationClass.description: Class that is the association class of this association

condition.description: «extend» (dependency with stereotype "extend"): when the extension applies

extensionPoint.description: «extend»: the extension point of the extended use case

languageModelTools.name: archery_delete_relationship
languageModelTools.userDescription: Delete a relationship from the model and remove its edge from all diagrams.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delete a relationship from the model and remove its edge from all diagrams.

languageModelTools.name: archery_get_diagram
languageModelTools.userDescription: Contents of a diagram with element names resolved from the model (canvas: nodes and edges; sequence: lifelines and steps; timing: lifelines with states and changes, messages, constraints).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Contents of a diagram with element names resolved from the model (canvas: nodes and edges; sequence: lifelines and steps; timing: lifelines with states and changes, messages, constraints). Canvas nodes come with their drawn box (x, y, w, h): text and children can make a box larger than the size it was given.

diagram.description: File name with or without extension, e.g. "building-blocks-l1"

languageModelTools.name: archery_create_diagram
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a canvas diagram (diagrams/<name>.uml.json) showing existing model elements.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a canvas diagram (diagrams/<name>.uml.json) showing existing model elements. Relationships between the shown elements are added automatically. Types: component, package, deployment, class, object, composite (composite structure), state, activity, interactionOverview, context (use cases). Sequence and communication diagrams: write_sequence_diagram; timing diagrams: write_timing_diagram. Embed it in a section with <!-- archery:diagram diagrams/<name>.uml.json -->.

name.description: File name without extension; default: kebab-case of the title

relationships.description: mostSpecific (default): leave out a container's relationship when one of its shown parts has the same relationship to the same partner (or a part of it); all: every relationship between shown elements

languageModelTools.name: archery_add_to_diagram
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show existing model elements on a canvas diagram (placed below the current content) and add the relationships between shown elements.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Show existing model elements on a canvas diagram (placed below the current content) and add the relationships between shown elements.

relationships.description: mostSpecific (default): leave out a container's relationship when one of its shown parts has the same relationship to the same partner (or a part of it); all: every relationship between shown elements

languageModelTools.name: archery_remove_from_diagram
languageModelTools.userDescription: Remove items from a canvas diagram only (the model is unchanged): element refs, relationship refs, and diagram-local node/edge ids (notes, states, actions, transitions, flows).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Remove items from a canvas diagram only (the model is unchanged): element refs, relationship refs, and diagram-local node/edge ids (notes, states, actions, transitions, flows). Removing a node also removes the edges attached to it; children of a removed local container move to its parent.

refs.description: Element, relationship, local node or local edge ids

languageModelTools.name: archery_write_sequence_diagram
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create (or with overwrite: true, replace) a sequence diagram for a runtime scenario (section 6).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create (or with overwrite: true, replace) a sequence diagram for a runtime scenario (section 6). Lifelines are model element ids (actors, components, external systems); elements used in messages are added as lifelines automatically. Steps: {msg: {from, to, label, kind: sync|async|reply|create|destroy|self|lost|found, async?: true for an asynchronous self/lost/found message, gate?: true when the missing end of a lost/found message is a gate on the frame (from / to outside the interaction)}}, {fragment: alt|opt|loop|par|break|critical|neg|strict|seq|ignore|consider|assert, branches: [{guard, steps}], min?, max? (loop iterations: loop(min,max), max "*" = unlimited)}, {fragment: "ref", label, over: [ids]}, {note, over: [ids]}. Embed with <!-- archery:diagram diagrams/<name>.seq.json -->.

name.description: File name without extension; default: kebab-case of the title

roles.description: Role names per lifeline id, shown as "role : Type" (default ":Type")

notation.description: Draw the interaction as a sequence diagram (default) or a communication diagram (participants with links and numbered messages)

languageModelTools.name: archery_write_timing_diagram
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create (or with overwrite: true, replace) a timing diagram: how the state of participants changes over time (section 6 runtime, or section 10 quality scenarios with deadlines).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create (or with overwrite: true, replace) a timing diagram: how the state of participants changes over time (section 6 runtime, or section 10 quality scenarios with deadlines). Lifelines: {ref: model element id, role?, form?: "state" (state timeline, default) | "value" (compact value lifeline), states: [top to bottom], changes: [{at, state}]}. Messages: {from, to, at, arrive?, label, kind: sync|async|reply}; leave out from (or to) for a message from (or to) a gate on the frame; from = to is a self message. Constraints: {on: lifeline id, from, to?, label}: a duration constraint from..to such as "0..2s", or a time constraint / observation at `from` (e.g. "t = now") when `to` is missing. Times are numbers in `unit` (e.g. "ms"). Embed with <!-- archery:diagram diagrams/<name>.timing.json -->.

name.description: File name without extension; default: kebab-case of the title

unit.description: Time unit shown on the axis, e.g. "ms"

end.description: End of the time axis (default: after the last event)

languageModelTools.name: archery_get_data
languageModelTools.userDescription: Items of a structured arc42 list stored in data/*.yaml.
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Items of a structured arc42 list stored in data/*.yaml. Lists:
- quality-goals (section 1.2, key field "id"): id, priority (integer, 1 = highest), quality (e.g. ISO 25010 / Q42 characteristic), goal, motivation
- stakeholders (section 1.3, key field "role"): role, contact, expectations (towards the architecture documentation)
- constraints (section 2, key field "id"): id, category (technical | organizational | convention), constraint, explanation
- quality-overview (section 10.1, key field "category"): category, description
- quality-scenarios (section 10.2, key field "id"): id, name, kind (usage | change), quality, goals (list of quality goal ids), priority; short form: context, stimulus, metric; long form: source, stimulus, environment, artifact, response, responseMeasure
- risks (section 11, key field "id"): id, kind (risk | debt), title, description, priority (high | medium | low), probability, impact, mitigation
- glossary (section 12, key field "term"): term, definition, translations (map language -> term), synonyms (list)

languageModelTools.userDescription: Add an item to a structured arc42 list, or update the item with the same key field (only the given fields change; null removes a field).
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Add an item to a structured arc42 list, or update the item with the same key field (only the given fields change; null removes a field). The result is validated before it is written. Lists:
- quality-goals (section 1.2, key field "id"): id, priority (integer, 1 = highest), quality (e.g. ISO 25010 / Q42 characteristic), goal, motivation
- stakeholders (section 1.3, key field "role"): role, contact, expectations (towards the architecture documentation)
- constraints (section 2, key field "id"): id, category (technical | organizational | convention), constraint, explanation
- quality-overview (section 10.1, key field "category"): category, description
- quality-scenarios (section 10.2, key field "id"): id, name, kind (usage | change), quality, goals (list of quality goal ids), priority; short form: context, stimulus, metric; long form: source, stimulus, environment, artifact, response, responseMeasure
- risks (section 11, key field "id"): id, kind (risk | debt), title, description, priority (high | medium | low), probability, impact, mitigation
- glossary (section 12, key field "term"): term, definition, translations (map language -> term), synonyms (list)

item.description: Fields of the item, including its key field

languageModelTools.userDescription: Delete an item from a structured arc42 list by its key field value (id, role, category or term).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delete an item from a structured arc42 list by its key field value (id, role, category or term).

languageModelTools.name: archery_validate
languageModelTools.userDescription: Check all documentation files: schemas, references between model, diagrams and data (unknown ids, hidden edges, invalid lifelines, scenarios pointing to unknown quality goals), and the layout of canvas diagrams (overlapping shapes, shapes over a container they are not in, labels covering shapes or labels; with coordinates).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check all documentation files: schemas, references between model, diagrams and data (unknown ids, hidden edges, invalid lifelines, scenarios pointing to unknown quality goals), and the layout of canvas diagrams (overlapping shapes, shapes over a container they are not in, labels covering shapes or labels; with coordinates). Call after making changes.

languageModelTools.name: archery_update_relationship
languageModelTools.userDescription: Change a relationship: kind, label, «stereotype», multiplicities, role names, qualifiers, navigability (association arrowheads), association class, or the condition / extension point of an «extend».
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Change a relationship: kind, label, «stereotype», multiplicities, role names, qualifiers, navigability (association arrowheads), association class, or the condition / extension point of an «extend». Pass null to clear a field. reverse: true swaps its ends (from / to, with their multiplicities, roles, qualifiers and navigability).

languageModelTools.userDescription: Change the title of any diagram (the file name stays: rename_diagram), the type of a canvas diagram (its content stays; the type decides what the editor offers to add), or what a canvas diagram shows: show.tags (tagged values in the boxes, default false) and show.keywords (relationship keywords such as «use» on the lines, default true).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Change the title of any diagram (the file name stays: rename_diagram), the type of a canvas diagram (its content stays; the type decides what the editor offers to add), or what a canvas diagram shows: show.tags (tagged values in the boxes, default false) and show.keywords (relationship keywords such as «use» on the lines, default true).

languageModelTools.userDescription: Set the position (absolute diagram coordinates, top-left corner) and optionally the size of nodes on a canvas diagram.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Set the position (absolute diagram coordinates, top-left corner) and optionally the size of nodes on a canvas diagram. `id` is an element ref or a diagram-local node id.

languageModelTools.name: archery_set_node_style
languageModelTools.userDescription: Presentation options of an element on one canvas diagram, e.g.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Presentation options of an element on one canvas diagram, e.g. { notation: "lollipop" } to draw an interface as a ball (provided via realization, required via usage = socket). Pass null to reset.

languageModelTools.name: archery_add_local_node
languageModelTools.userDescription: Add a node that exists only on this diagram: a note, or a state machine / activity node.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Add a node that exists only on this diagram: a note, or a state machine / activity node. Kinds: note, state, initial, final, choice, junction, fork, join, history, deepHistory, terminate, region, entryPoint, exitPoint, action, activityFinal, flowFinal, decision, merge, object, partition, sendSignal, acceptEvent, acceptTimeEvent, pin, interruptibleRegion, interactionUse, interaction. States take "text" for internal activities (one per line, e.g. "entry / start timer"); partitions (swimlanes), states, regions and interruptible regions contain other local nodes via parent; parent can also be an element shown on the diagram (a note inside a component). Orthogonal regions: "region" nodes with a state as parent (they fill the state, separated by dashed lines). entryPoint / exitPoint sit on the border of their parent state; a "pin" sits on the border of its parent action; acceptTimeEvent is the hourglass (name e.g. "every 5 min").

diagram_ref.description: interactionUse / interaction nodes: the diagram they stand for, e.g. "diagrams/checkout.seq.json"

languageModelTools.name: archery_update_local_node
languageModelTools.userDescription: Change a note, state or activity node: name, text, kind or parent (null clears).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Change a note, state or activity node: name, text, kind or parent (null clears).

diagram_ref.description: interactionUse / interaction nodes: the diagram they stand for (null clears)

languageModelTools.modelDescription: Connect two nodes on a canvas diagram with a diagram-local edge: "transition" (state machines, label "trigger [guard] / effect"), "flow" (activities, label "[guard]"), "interrupt" (an interrupting edge leaving an interruptible region, drawn as a lightning bolt), or "anchor" (dashed line from a note to anything). Ends are local node ids or element refs on the diagram.

languageModelTools.modelDescription: Change the label or kind of a diagram-local edge (null clears the label).

languageModelTools.userDescription: Set the bend points of an edge on a canvas diagram (absolute coordinates; [] for a straight line).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Set the bend points of an edge on a canvas diagram (absolute coordinates; [] for a straight line). `id` is a relationship ref or a local edge id.

languageModelTools.name: archery_set_label_offset
languageModelTools.userDescription: Move a label on a canvas diagram away from its default place: the label of an edge (`id` is a relationship ref or a local edge id) or the outer name of a local node (entry / exit point, pin, decision, accept time event).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Move a label on a canvas diagram away from its default place: the label of an edge (`id` is a relationship ref or a local edge id) or the outer name of a local node (entry / exit point, pin, decision, accept time event). `offset` is relative to the default place; null puts the label back. A moved label is tied to its line or shape by a dotted line.

languageModelTools.name: archery_auto_layout
languageModelTools.userDescription: Arrange all nodes of a canvas diagram automatically (ELK layered layout): clients above what they use, superclasses / interfaces above their specializations, initial nodes first and final nodes last, few crossings, room for edge labels; containers fit their children, regions stack in their state, ports stay on their component; bend points and moved labels are reset.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Arrange all nodes of a canvas diagram automatically (ELK layered layout): clients above what they use, superclasses / interfaces above their specializations, initial nodes first and final nodes last, few crossings, room for edge labels; containers fit their children, regions stack in their state, ports stay on their component; bend points and moved labels are reset. direction: DOWN, RIGHT, UP, LEFT (default: RIGHT for use case diagrams, else DOWN).

languageModelTools.name: archery_write_data_table
languageModelTools.userDescription: Replace all rows of a structured arc42 list (data/*.yaml) at once, and optionally its column layout (visible columns, their order and labels; extra columns become custom fields on the items).
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Replace all rows of a structured arc42 list (data/*.yaml) at once, and optionally its column layout (visible columns, their order and labels; extra columns become custom fields on the items). Rows are objects of field -> text; numbers, comma-separated lists and "key: value" maps are converted per field. Rows without an id get one. Lists:
- quality-goals (section 1.2, key field "id"): id, priority (integer, 1 = highest), quality (e.g. ISO 25010 / Q42 characteristic), goal, motivation
- stakeholders (section 1.3, key field "role"): role, contact, expectations (towards the architecture documentation)
- constraints (section 2, key field "id"): id, category (technical | organizational | convention), constraint, explanation
- quality-overview (section 10.1, key field "category"): category, description
- quality-scenarios (section 10.2, key field "id"): id, name, kind (usage | change), quality, goals (list of quality goal ids), priority; short form: context, stimulus, metric; long form: source, stimulus, environment, artifact, response, responseMeasure
- risks (section 11, key field "id"): id, kind (risk | debt), title, description, priority (high | medium | low), probability, impact, mitigation
- glossary (section 12, key field "term"): term, definition, translations (map language -> term), synonyms (list)

width.description: Column width in percent of the table; omit for automatic

columns.description: Visible columns in order; omit to keep the current layout

merges.description: Merged cells (spreadsheet style); omit to keep the current ones

languageModelTools.modelDescription: The Markdown of an arc42 chapter (its file in sections/), with the generated parts as directives: <!-- archery:diagram diagrams/x.uml.json caption="..." -->, <!-- archery:table data/x.yaml caption="..." -->, <!-- archery:caption "..." --> before a Markdown table, <!-- archery:decisions decisions -->, <!-- archery:help ... --> (arc42 guidance, keep it).

languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replace the whole Markdown of a chapter (keep its "# Title" line, the archery:help guidance and the directives you do not mean to remove). Prefer edit_section for changes to part of a chapter. The open document shows the chapter while it changes.

languageModelTools.name: archery_edit_section

languageModelTools.modelDescription: Change part of a chapter: replace the exact text `find` with `replace` (once; `all` for every occurrence). `find` must occur in the chapter (get_section shows it). languageModelTools.modelDescription: Show a diagram, a data table or the list of architecture decisions in a chapter, with an optional caption: at the end of the part under `after_heading` (a heading text of the chapter), else at the end of the chapter. languageModelTools.name: archery_export_document
languageModelTools.userDescription: Export the whole architecture document as PDF (needs Edge, Chrome or Chromium) or as one self-contained HTML file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Export the whole architecture document as PDF (needs Edge, Chrome or Chromium) or as one self-contained HTML file. `file`: where to write it, relative to the workspace (default: next to the documentation folder). `settings`: export options (font, fontSize, pageSize, orientation, margins, header, footer, pageNumbers, tocDepth, ...); they are saved for the next export.

languageModelTools.name: archery_export_diagram
languageModelTools.userDescription: Export one diagram as an SVG or PNG image.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Export one diagram as an SVG or PNG image. `file`: where to write it, relative to the workspace (default: next to the diagram file).

languageModelTools.name: archery_set_line_shape
languageModelTools.userDescription: How lines are drawn on a canvas diagram: straight, orthogonal (right angles), curved, horizontalFirst / verticalFirst (one corner: across first, or up / down first), or auto (the diagram style decides: straight in Classic, right angles in Modern).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: How lines are drawn on a canvas diagram: straight, orthogonal (right angles), curved, horizontalFirst / verticalFirst (one corner: across first, or up / down first), or auto (the diagram style decides: straight in Classic, right angles in Modern). `ids`: relationship refs or local edge ids; omit them for every line of the diagram.

languageModelTools.name: archery_batch
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run several Archery operations in one call, in order, as one change: when one fails, nothing is changed and the error says which.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run several Archery operations in one call, in order, as one change: when one fails, nothing is changed and the error says which. Each operation is {tool, input}, e.g. {tool: "add_element", input: {name: "Orders", kind: "component"}}; later operations see what earlier ones did. Use it to add many elements, relationships, local nodes or edges at once. Versions and export cannot be batched.

languageModelTools.name: archery_set_project
languageModelTools.userDescription: Change the system name, the document title or the authors in archery.yaml (shown on the title page and in exports).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Change the system name, the document title or the authors in archery.yaml (shown on the title page and in exports).

languageModelTools.name: archery_delete_diagram
languageModelTools.userDescription: Delete a diagram file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delete a diagram file. Fails while a chapter shows it or an element links to it (detail), unless force is true, which also removes those chapter directives and links.

languageModelTools.name: archery_rename_diagram
languageModelTools.userDescription: Give a diagram a new file name (diagrams/<name>.<type>.json); chapter directives, element detail links and interaction overview references follow.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Give a diagram a new file name (diagrams/<name>.<type>.json); chapter directives, element detail links and interaction overview references follow. The title stays (change it with update_diagram).

name.description: New file name without extension, e.g. "deployment-bench"

languageModelTools.name: archery_update_decision
languageModelTools.userDescription: Change an architecture decision record: its status, title, context, decision, consequences, the quality goals / constraints it addresses, or which earlier decision it supersedes (that one then gets status superseded).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Change an architecture decision record: its status, title, context, decision, consequences, the quality goals / constraints it addresses, or which earlier decision it supersedes (that one then gets status superseded). `decision`: its number ("3", "0003") or file name.

supersedes.description: Number of the decision this one replaces
